## TRA Timeline

#### Up-C IPO and TRA execution

- 2021-12-16: Form-of TRA filed as Exhibit 10.8 to the S-1
- 2022-01-12: IPO closed; TRA executed
- 2022-03-28: Executed TRA filed as Exhibit 10.8 to the FY2021 10-K

#### Angelo Gordon acquisition and Amended and Restated TRA

- 2023-05-12: Form of Amended and Restated TRA referenced in the Angelo Gordon transaction announcement 8-K
- 2023-11-01: Angelo Gordon acquisition closed; Amended and Restated TRA filed as Exhibit 10.3 to the closing 8-K (collapses three Operating Groups into Operating Group II; Angelo Gordon partners join as additional TRA Parties via joinder)

## Explanation

TPG Inc. executed this TRA on January 12, 2022 at the closing of its Up-C IPO, agreeing to pay 85% of net cash tax savings from Section 754 basis step-ups generated by future exchanges of Common Units in the TPG Operating Groups for Class A common stock. The TRA was Amended and Restated on November 1, 2023 in connection with the Angelo Gordon acquisition: the "TOG Restructuring" collapsed three TPG Operating Group L.P.s into Operating Group II, and the new Angelo Gordon partners joined the same TRA as additional TRA Parties via a Partner Acknowledgment and Joinder rather than entering a separate parallel contract, so TPG continues to operate with a single TRA. Economic terms (85% rate, Section 754 basis step-ups, imputed-interest deductions, Article IV early-termination mechanics) survive the restatement unchanged. The recognized TRA liability grew from $6.3M in 2023 to a $308.9M new layer recorded during FY2024 as exchanges accelerated; the TRA remains in force through the FY2025 10-K. See `contract_log.md` for the full filing-by-filing record.
